_about: Representative job postings for `interview_benchmark --only plan --postings`. Written for the benchmark, across industries and seniority, so kit quality is not measured only on the mostly technical demo postings. None of these exist in the database; kits generated from them are not stored.

postings.title: Staff Nurse — Medical Ward
postings.description: You will care for twenty-four adult medical patients per shift on a busy general ward. Give timed medication safely and keep the medication chart accurate. Hand over clearly at shift change so nothing is missed. Recognise a deteriorating patient early using the early warning score and escalate to the doctor. Support families who are anxious and often frightened.

postings.title: Junior Accountant
postings.description: A distribution company with 300 customers on credit. You will post supplier invoices, reconcile the three bank accounts every week, and chase overdue customer balances. You will prepare the VAT workings each month for the finance manager to review. Accuracy matters more than speed.

postings.title: Sales Executive — FMCG
postings.description: Cover sixty grocery shops across Lalitpur on a weekly route. Take orders, get our products onto the right shelves, and win back shops that have stopped ordering. Report competitor prices and promotions you see. Your target is monthly revenue from your route.

postings.title: Customer Support Team Lead
postings.description: Lead a team of twelve agents answering phone and chat for an internet provider. Keep first-response times under two minutes during evening peaks. Coach agents using call reviews, handle escalated complaints yourself, and tell the network team when the same fault keeps generating calls. You own the weekly rota.

postings.title: Primary School Teacher (Grade 4)
postings.description: Teach thirty-two grade four students English, maths and science. Plan lessons for mixed abilities, including children still learning to read fluently. Assess progress each term and meet parents to explain it. Keep a calm classroom where every child takes part.

postings.title: Marketing Manager
postings.description: Own marketing for a chain of eight fitness centres. Set the annual plan and a budget of forty lakh rupees, run membership campaigns across social media and local radio, and prove which campaigns bring in members who stay. Manage two coordinators and an outside design agency.

postings.title: Data Analyst Intern
postings.description: A six-month internship with the growth team of a food delivery app. Pull order data with SQL, clean it in Python or spreadsheets, and build weekly charts showing where orders drop off between browsing and checkout. Present one finding to the team every fortnight.

postings.title: Civil Site Engineer
postings.description: Supervise construction of a seven-storey reinforced concrete building. Check that formwork, reinforcement and concrete pours match the drawings before they are signed off. Keep the daily site diary, manage subcontractor progress against the schedule, and enforce safety rules for workers at height.

postings.title: Restaurant Manager
postings.description: Run a 120-seat restaurant open for lunch and dinner. Hire, train and schedule a staff of thirty-five. Control food cost and wastage, keep kitchen hygiene audit-ready, and handle guest complaints on the floor. You are accountable for monthly profit.

postings.title: Graphic Designer
postings.description: Design packaging, point-of-sale posters and social media artwork for a tea brand sold in supermarkets and online. Work from briefs written by the brand manager, prepare print-ready files that printers accept first time, and keep every design within the brand guidelines.
